paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Tosefta Eduyot, after Rabbi; Zuckermandel’s edition reads ר״ח bar Iddai.[^1][^2]

notes.text: סוף עדיות gives end of Eduyot. התוס׳ צוקערמאנדעל is read contextually as Zuckermandel’s Tosefta edition, without fresh collation. The variant prints only ר״ח; Chananyah is a plausible contextual expansion but remains unconfirmed, so the initials are retained literally. Iddai differs from the heading’s Iddo, without identity merger.

אחר רבי supplies a full Rabbi but does not explicitly say whether after is textual sequence or chronology; the literal after remains, without identifying Rabbi or claiming succession. Heading ר׳ remains R'; full רבי in the other occurrence does not expand it.
